title: Continual path reuse before module birth
hypothesis: On a continual task stream with six functions sharing a rank-one update direction and two unrelated outliers, a shared module plus one scalar task View should meet held-out RMSE <=0.035 with at most three physical modules and <=0.75x actual bytes of a PathNet-style reuse-then-birth policy, while retaining early-task quality after later tasks; the direct rank-one native control tests Mirror attribution.
physical_object: shared 4x4 linear module and a shared rank-one update basis
mirror_coordinate: one scalar per-task coefficient on a shared rank-one update basis; birth a private full module only when support RMSE exceeds 0.05
logical_multiplicity: continual task functions first share existing path/module state and only outliers receive private modules
controls: PathNet-style frozen path/module reuse followed by full-module birth when support RMSE exceeds 0.05
one shared full module with no task View
shared module plus scalar rank-one task coordinate (direct native rank-one/LoRA-equivalent alias control)
independent full matrix per task upper control

task.type: continual 4D linear regression stream, six tasks share one seeded rank-one update direction and two tasks are independent outliers

development.selection_metric: mean query RMSE over all eight tasks after the complete stream; also report per-task RMSE, early-task retention, module births and payload bytes

compute.retention_metric: query RMSE on all earlier tasks recomputed after the final task; report maximum absolute increase relative to the task's first accepted state

gates.PROMISING: Both seeds: mean query RMSE across all tasks <=0.035, every aligned task <=0.035, at most three physical modules total, actual payload <=0.75x PathNet, and maximum early-task RMSE increase <=0.01. Native rank-one control must not exactly match Mirror function and payload.
gates.FAIL: Either seed misses a PROMISING gate, native rank-one control exactly matches Mirror, or independent full modules are both more accurate and no more than 1.25x Mirror actual bytes.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent upper control has mean query RMSE >0.025, or actual serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Synthetic task stream with an intentionally shared rank-one subspace; no natural continual-learning claim.
The native rank-one control is the same mathematical map W + m u v^T and is expected to test exact functional attribution.
The independent bank is a quality upper bound, not a capacity comparison at matched bytes.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless every frozen PROMISING gate passes.
